Budget.title: Budget
Budget.description: A monthly limit for one spending category. Sent and returned in `/budgets`.

ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody
ErrorBody.description: The body of every non-2xx response (error-format.md).

ExpenseCreate.title: ExpenseCreate
ExpenseCreate.description: `POST /expenses`: a manual expense, optionally attached to a failed receipt.

ExpenseUpdate.title: ExpenseUpdate
ExpenseUpdate.description:
`PATCH /expenses/{id}`: only the fields sent change.

Fields that are required in `ExpenseCreate` may be left out but not sent as `null`.
`line_items`, if sent, replaces the list.

Flag.title: Flag
Flag.description: A rule result on an expense, e.g. `sum_mismatch` on `total`.

Goal.title: Goal
Goal.description: The savings goal. Sent and returned in `/goal`; `monthly_income` is always dumped.

Health.title: Health
Health.description: `GET /api/health`. Always returned with 200 while the app runs.

ItemCategory.title: ItemCategory
ItemCategory.description: One entry of the item lookup table.

LineItemInput.title: LineItemInput
LineItemInput.description: A line item as sent by the client; the server derives `normalized_name`.

ReceiptUpload.title: ReceiptUpload
ReceiptUpload.description: `POST /receipts`: the multipart form (jpeg, png or webp, at most `MAX_UPLOAD_MB`).
